meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或文案转成发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的产品要发布或展示,需要宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a launch video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product or feature and need a quick promo video.

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或需求说明，制作成产品发布/推广视频。Claude 会按固定流程执行：初始化项目、抓取页面素材、设计视觉风格、编排故事板与脚本、生成逐帧 HTML，最后渲染出 MP4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当你给出产品的商业链接、想宣传或发布某个产品时触发；也接受网站导览/展示类请求。若意图不明确，会转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这个产品页面做成一条发布视频。
say.note: Claude会采集页面并生成视频。

say.text: 根据这段脚本做一条功能展示视频。
say.note: 会先把脚本存为user_script.txt再规划。

say.text: 把这个公司官网做成一次网站导览视频。
say.note: 按展示原貌的方式处理。

howto.what_en: Turn a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch/promo video. Runs the HyperFrames pipeline: setup, capture, design system, storyboard & script, frames, final render, and outputs a video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or pastes a commercial URL; site tours/showcases also route here. Unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this product page into a launch video.
say_en.note: Claude captures the page and generates the video.

say_en.text: Make a feature reveal video from this script.
say_en.note: Script is saved as user_script.txt first.

say_en.text: Create a site tour video for this website.
